snippet.title: Last Round at the End of the World | Teaser #folkhorror
snippet.description:
Wishlist Last Round to support the devs: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4746890/Last_Round_at_the_End_of_the_World/

Last Round at the End of the World is a folk-horror narrative puzzle game where you interpret divine messages, question characters, and choose who must die to keep an island alive.

Instead of fearing the sacrifice, like in The Wicker Man and Midsommar, this time, you are the Adjudicator.

Once a year, the Spirit of the Waters speaks: it gives you a poetic riddle pointing to one soul among the villagers.

Choose right, and one person drowns so the rest may live.
Choose wrong, and the water takes everyone.
